COMMON QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between Low EC and High EC Cocopeat?

Low EC (< 0.5 mS/cm) has been thoroughly washed to remove naturally occurring sodium and potassium salts. It is essential for sensitive root systems, nursery germination, and greenhouse vegetables. High EC (> 1.5 mS/cm) is unwashed raw cocopeat, suited for landscaping, mature trees, and animal bedding where salt levels are less critical.

What is your Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)?

Our minimum wholesale dispatch quantity is 1 Metric Ton (approximately 200 blocks of 5kg each, or equivalent in loose bags). For initial quality verification, we supply single 5kg sample blocks via courier.

How fast can you deliver to Maharashtra (Nashik, Pune, Sangli)?

Because our manufacturing facility is located in Udhna, Surat right along the NH48 freight corridor, truckloads dispatched from our factory reach Nashik and Pune within 18 to 24 hours.

Do you provide GST tax invoices and weighbridge slips?

Yes, 100% legitimate B2B factory operations. Every single dispatch is accompanied by an authorized GST invoice, computerized weighbridge slips, and a batch lab test certificate verifying EC and moisture percentages.
